# `gcp.regionsslpolicy`

Represents a Regional SSL policy. SSL policies give you the ability to control the features of SSL that your SSL proxy or HTTPS load balancer negotiates.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/SslPolicy` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
